name: Spirit Latte
source:
Jay has been running the family coffee shop all by himself ever since his father fell into a coma. But it hasn't been too difficult, because strangely, not a single customer has walked through the doors in weeks. One day, he meets someone who warns him that his store is haunted.

Can Jay save his coffee shop and learn to get along with this strange man? And is the ghost really the only thing that's haunting him?

[From [url=https://coco-adventurer.itch.io/spirit-latte]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
自从父亲昏迷后，杰伊就一直独自经营家庭咖啡店。但这并不太困难，因为奇怪的是，几周来没有一个顾客进门。有一天，他遇到一个人，警告他他的商店闹鬼。

杰伊能拯救他的咖啡店并学会与这个陌生男人相处吗？幽灵真的是唯一困扰他的东西吗？

[来自[url=https://coco-adventurer.itch.io/spirit-latte]itch.io[/url]]
